verdicts.tldr: one realm registers the same symbol once per realm.Sub identity, and a sub-created token cannot be registered from its host frame
verdicts.details: grc20reg.Register reads rlmPath from cur.Previous().PkgPath() (grc20reg.gno:39), which carries the "#sub" realm.Sub synthesizes, and keys with fqname.Construct(rlmPath, symbol). Nothing strips the subpath, so "host#a.SREG", "host#b.SREG" and "host.SREG" coexist for one realm, against the overwrite/alias guard Register's godoc states at grc20reg.gno:28-31. The HasPrefix guard at grc20reg.gno:43 compares against Token.ID(), which keeps the raw creation path, so the host frame is refused for a token its own realm created under a sub identity even though origRealm strips that subpath precisely to keep the token with the host.
verdicts.evidence: gno test -v ./gno.land/p/nt/grc20/v0: key a: gno.land/r/demo/grc20subdup#a.SREG, key b: gno.land/r/demo/grc20subdup#b.SREG, key c: gno.land/r/demo/grc20subdup.SREG, all three PASS; the host-frame filetest aborts with grc20reg: token must be registered from its own realm at grc20reg.gno:44
verdicts.verify_by: two filetests copied into examples/gno.land/p/nt/grc20/v0/filetests, run with gno test -v ./gno.land/p/nt/grc20/v0

verdicts.tldr: the grc721 NewToken godoc and the construction comment 27 lines below it disagree about origRealm
verdicts.details: Line 13 reads "its PkgPath becomes the unforgeable origRealm"; line 40, which this diff rewrote, says origRealm is the host path with the subpath stripped. The diff made the same correction in grc20's NewToken godoc and left grc721's.
verdicts.verify_by: read both comments at the head

verdicts.tldr: the ADR behind the home binding is the last place spelling the separator ":subpath"
verdicts.details: grep over the head worktree returns exactly one hit for ":subpath" after this diff, in the ADR the corrected comments describe.

verdicts.tldr: the separator is "#", so the correction holds
verdicts.details: Both definitions of the constant are "#", and chain.SplitPkgSubPath cuts on it.
verdicts.evidence: gnovm/pkg/gnolang/uverse.go:255 and gnovm/stdlibs/chain/address.gno:13 both read const subRealmSep = "#"; uverse.go:1732 synthesizes host + subRealmSep + subpath
verdicts.verify_by: grep for subRealmSep in the runtime and the chain stdlib

verdicts.tldr: Token.ID() does keep the raw creation pkgpath, subpath included
verdicts.details: NewToken builds id from pkgPath, the unsplit rlm.PkgPath(), and derives origRealm separately through chain.SplitPkgSubPath.
verdicts.evidence: a token created under cur.Sub("vault") prints id: gno.land/r/demo/grc20subhost#vault.SHOS.0000000
verdicts.verify_by: read the construction and print a sub-created token's ID()

verdicts.tldr: the key is the id without its trailing sequence id whenever Register returns
verdicts.details: fqname.Construct joins with a dot and Register aborts unless Token.ID() starts with key + ".", so a returned key is always that prefix. What the sentence leaves out is the frame it is true of, which is candidate 1.
verdicts.evidence: key c: gno.land/r/demo/grc20subdup.SREG for id gno.land/r/demo/grc20subdup.SREG.0000002
verdicts.verify_by: read fqname.Construct and the HasPrefix guard, then register a token and print the key
